prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["HD Render Preset"]
1: ["Secure Your Pet & Access Across Devices", "Your companion progress is tied to your account credentials.", "Continue with Safe Auth", "Session Safeguard Enabled"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Companion Environment", "Verifying Display Coordinates"]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, switch modes, or hide it to your system tray.", "Quick Keys: Right-Click to open menu | Drag to move", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
4: ["Upload High Quality Photos for Best Results", "Clear Lighting & Well-Framed"]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Enter Pet Name", "Verified Adoption Identity"]
6: ["Tip: Make sure your pet is not hidden behind active full-screen windows."]
7: ["Select Your Journey"]
8: ["Signing in ensures your pet status and customization are saved safely to the cloud.", "Cloud Save Protected"]
9: ["Quick Desktop Controls Overview", "Use system tray or click your pet directly to access companion options anytime."]
